basics.name: Yanan He
basics.summary: CS, Math & Stats @ Purdue | Aspiring AI Researcher. Research interests include AI for science, trustworthy/interpretable AI, and foundation models.

work.company: Stony Brook University, Stony Brook, NY
highlights: Project I: MTS-JEPA: Multi-Resolution Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Time-Series Anomaly Prediction.
Led a self-supervised framework for time-series anomaly prediction using a multiscale JEPA-style architecture.
Addressed JEPA representation collapse with a soft-quantized codebook latent space.
Achieved state-of-the-art benchmark performance; manuscript submitted to ICML 2026.
Project II: Walking in the Ball: Hyperbolic Latent Navigation for Structured Thought Generation.
Leading hyperbolic latent navigation research for LLM reasoning using Poincare-ball embeddings and geodesic flows.
Designing training and evaluation pipeline; target submission to NeurIPS 2026.

work.summary: Advisor: Mingli He. Project: Machine Learning and Global Epidemiological Modeling for Stroke Risk and Outcome Prediction.
highlights: Served as co-corresponding author with methodological oversight for an interdisciplinary team.
Contributed to design and evaluation of an interpretable XGBoost model for clinical decision support (ROC-AUC > 0.90).
Guided statistical and machine learning modeling using generalized additive models (GAMs).
Contributed to manuscript preparation and peer-review revision.

work.summary: Advisor: Chaoyan Yue. Project: Global Epidemiological Modeling of Ischemic Stroke in Young Adults (1990-2021).
highlights: Analyzed global ischemic stroke trends using GBD 2021 data with Joinpoint regression and Bayesian APC models.
Contributed to data cleaning, statistical analysis, figure preparation, and methods/results writing.
